verdict.rationale: SumUp's docs explicitly confirm refunds can be issued full or partial to the original payment method via the online payments refund guide/API (sumup-docs-16/23), satisfying the API channel of the story. However, there is no evidence describing refund initiation from the physical POS terminal or the merchant dashboard UI, so the multi-channel claim is only partially supported. Missing for 10: dashboard refund UI documentation, POS/terminal refund flow evidence, independent confirmation of refund behavior.
